acceptanceCriteria: Refuse a complete shard set whose overlapping file blob declarations conflict, with a named reason; compare must be INCOMPARABLE and never PARITY.
Add an acceptance regression for the reproduced conflicting-blob set while preserving valid unions of disjoint file declarations and byte-identical single-repeat goldens.
body: Confirmed on reviewed HEAD 45d1cb07dbf13075920f4faf1d174b01890c572f versus base 645304a2fb71065f9061d8d8d866600d703e84c6 for GH #810. Runtime: Go 1.27.2 darwin/arm64. Load shard-1-of-3.json, shard-2-of-3.json, shard-3-of-3.json; change shard 3 corvintRunIdentity.testFileBlobs[a.spec.js] to DIFFERENT-BLOB. Compare against whole.json yields PARITY with no reasons. Stability refuses the cart tests with IDENTITY_INPUT_MISSING. shardGroupKey ignores overlapping testFileBlobs conflicts; mergeShards retains conflicts, but Compare inspects only merged logical runs and never rejects the within-set conflict. Expected: differing overlapping identity declarations cannot become a comparable logical run. Reproduction: temporary overlay TestReviewProbe/conflicting_shard_blobs; source internal/playwrightruns/shards.go:121,163-174 and compare.go:168-196. Existing TestShardSetRefusals covers application revision mismatch but not blob conflicts.

completion.reason: Codex round-1 finding fixed: test-file blobs are part of the shard group key, so a shard set with conflicting blob declarations is refused (SHARD_INPUTS_NOT_DECLARED/incomparable) and never merged into PARITY; regression test added (PWR-V0-011..023, accepted). Codex round 2 PASS. Delivered in beamfall/corvint#816, merged to main at 469f260b8. Tests on go1.27.2: the batch's focused packages PASS, go vet clean, doc gates PASS, CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.

title: runs compare: conflicting shard file blobs are merged into PARITY
